dog.description_text:
Meet Wolfie! 🐾

Wolfie is a medium-sized pup who was found as a stray and is now ready to find a loving home of his own. He's been incredibly social with our staff and has quickly shown us what a sweet, friendly guy he is.

One of Wolfie's most adorable features is his cute little underbite, which makes his already charming face even more lovable! He could benefit from some basic manners training to help him become his best self, but we think he has all the makings of a wonderful companion.

With his friendly personality and adaptable nature, Wolfie could do well in a variety of homes. If you're looking for a sweet, social dog with plenty of personality, Wolfie may be your perfect match! ❤️
